summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Iteration 7 RepoSeries functionality. All backend series API endpoints passed (9/9 tests, 100%). All frontend History page features passed (16/16 tests, 100%). The new repository series model works correctly with 25 series for 26 runs, branch awareness, run appending, score deltas, archive functionality, and proper UI integration.

minor_issues.issue: CSV row count mismatch in existing test (expected 41, got 103)
minor_issues.impact: Pre-existing issue from earlier iterations, not related to series functionality

passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/series returns 25 series for 26 runs with correct counts (5 active, 20 archived)
Backend: Branch awareness verified - northwind-labs/proposal-writer@develop and northwind-labs/agentic-crm@main are separate series
Backend: myday-2.0 series (SER-C7EB608470FE) has 2 runs with correct scores (79→55, delta -24)
Backend: GET /api/scans/{id} includes series_id, run_number, score_delta and embedded series object
Backend: All 5 export links work (pdf_full, pdf_redacted, csv, draft_zip, handoff_zip) plus print and export-preview
Backend: PATCH /api/series/{id}/archive toggles archived status and updates counts correctly
Backend: GET /api/series/export/archive returns valid zip with manifest.csv, README.txt, PDFs and CSVs
Backend: POST /api/series/backfill is idempotent (0 scans attached on second call)
Backend: Retention rule removed - POST /api/admin/retention does NOT delete scans, config shows keep_recent_scans=null and prune_old_scans=false
Frontend: History page loads with correct subtitle (25 repositories, 26 runs, 5 active, 20 archived)
Frontend: Verdict distribution chart displays correctly
Frontend: Search input filters by repository/owner/branch
Frontend: All 5 sort options work (recent, worst, best, runs, name)
Frontend: Active series table shows 5 series
Frontend: Series row expansion shows nested runs table
Frontend: myday-2.0 series displays correctly (score 55, verdict Wasteful, delta -24, 2 runs visible)
Frontend: Run details show correctly (Run #1: score 79, delta 'first run'; Run #2: score 55, delta -24)
Frontend: Archive section starts collapsed and expands to show 20 archived series
Frontend: Archive/unarchive buttons present on correct rows
Frontend: Download archive bundle button visible and enabled
Frontend: Delete confirmation dialogs show correct text ('Delete this repository?' vs 'Delete this run?')
Frontend: Delete dialogs can be cancelled
Frontend: Landing page loads
Frontend: New scan page loads with source options
Frontend: Settings page loads
Frontend: Scan results page loads with all data
Frontend: Exports page loads
Frontend: VS Code handoff page loads
